review_scope: Narrow static review of the auxiliary 20-cycle capacity-change forecasting capability subgate. No model construction, fit, prediction, development/test feature access, raw-cycle read, checkpoint access, or shared-state/lock change was performed.

cohort_and_split.split_contract: The reviewed cohort is hash-identical to the immutable cohort from the preceding narrow review; the manifest hashes and first-five-per-batch SHA split were checked there. No manifests were reopened in this task.

asof_features_and_target.scope_note: The interface and runner enforce row-level as-of cutoff and keep the s+20 measurement in the label expression only. The feature-builder implementation was outside the permitted read scope, so the internal past-only TheilSen calculation is not independently recomputed in this report.

fit_budget_failure_and_checkpoint.checkpoint_write_only: pickle.dump of the estimator trained by this one fit; file opened xb and never deserialized by this runner
fit_budget_failure_and_checkpoint.failure_behavior: A failure after fit-start records one consumed fit; a failure before fit-start still leaves the exclusive invocation claim, so this runner cannot be automatically reinvoked.

execution_gate.required_before_run: Project owner must issue a fresh ROOT_GO.json with status GO_ONE_AUX_CAPACITY_CPU_FIT_CAL_ONLY, bound to the three reviewed hashes and the exact one-auxiliary-fit/calibration-only budget. Do not reuse an old GO.

limitations: 10 calibration cells are already used in research development and are not independent confirmation.
Cohort isolation is by source batch/index; physical serial identity and full-source SHA remain unverified.
Observed-event laboratory complete-cycle capacity only; no natural-censoring or strict IV-only claim.
No RUL correction model or development/test evidence is produced by this subgate.
